display.title: Episode 492: The Strange Visitor (Elul)
display.summary_short: Early Elul 5751: young Yisroel, an orphan who learns Torah alone in a forest cave, meets a mysterious visitor; plus Shema with a Tzivos Hashem club member and Reb Nature's 'Mitzvah Man'.
display.summary_long: The show opens with a lively march and a sponsor message. A Tzivos Hashem club member returns to Studio 604 to talk about fighting the yetzer hara with Torah and mitzvos and to lead the Shema, followed by tzedakah. Story time is 'The Strange Visitor'. Little Yisroel was orphaned at five, but never forgot his father's last words: fear nothing and no one, only Hashem. He finds an empty cave in the woods and secretly goes there with his siddur, Chumash and Tehillim to daven and learn. One day footsteps approach, and an old man with a silvery beard and sparkling eyes asks whether he is afraid all alone. Yisroel answers that he is never alone, because Hashem is with him. The stranger offers to help, and Yisroel asks only for a teacher; from then on they learn together every day. Uncle Yossi reveals that the boy grew up to be the Baal Shem Tov. Reb Nature and his fiddler then sing 'Mitzvah Man'. The show ends with a reminder to hear the shofar in shul every morning of Elul, Shabbos candle-lighting time and wishes for a ksivah vachasimah tovah.
display.lesson: Fear nothing and no one but Hashem; one who learns Torah is never alone.

date.note: Elul shofar in shul each morning; Shabbos candles 7:34 fits Friday 16 Aug 1991; one week after ep. 491 (Rosh Chodesh Elul 10-11 Aug).
